name: Misuzu
source:
An incredibly talented scientist and researcher, as well as the protagonist's older sister. She has a bright atmosphere and is extremely intelligent, but also has a mischievous side to her. Through her research, she has successfully managed to convert human memory into data.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2019/10/04/ae/]official website[/url]]
